argv: Add a function add(a, b) to src/math.ts and a test in src/math.test.ts, then run 'node --test src/*.test.ts'. Keep it minimal.
notes: Different envelope from SSE: {type,timestamp,sessionID,part}. type is step_start|text|tool_use|step_finish (snake_case), while part.type stays kebab-case (step-start/step-finish). Only terminal tool states are emitted (no pending/running).
